title: Taraxasterol regulates p53 transcriptional activity to inhibit pancreatic cancer by inducing MDM2 ubiquitination degradation.
authors: Han, Anna; Liu, Jiajing; Du, Pan; Li, Wenxuan; Quan, Haiyan; Lin, Zhenhua; Chen, Liyan
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Taraxasterol通过诱导MDM2泛素化降解调控p53转录活性抑制胰腺癌，虽涉及p53转录调控和分子对接，但核心是药物抗肿瘤机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究，方法以湿实验为主，AI/物理模拟仅浅层应用。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Pancreatic cancer (PC) is a malignant tumor with complex development mechanisms and a poor prognosis. Taraxasterol (TAX), a pentacyclic triterpenoid plant sterol derived from Taraxacum mongolicum, has multiple biological activities including an anti-tumor effect. However, the mechanism by which TAX exerts its anticancer effects in PC remains unclear. PURPOSE: This study aimed to elucidate the molecular mechanism by which TAX suppresses the proliferation of PC. METHODS: The intersection of TAX and PC targets was obtained through network pharmacology. RNA-seq was used to identify TAX-induced differentially expressed genes in PC. Molecular docking, CETSA, western blot analysis, and qRT-PCR were performed to confirm the effectiveness of targets. The influence of TAX on PC was assessed by analyzing proliferation, apoptosis, and the cell cycle via MTT assay, colony formation assay, and flow cytometry, respectively. Co-IP assay and immunofluorescence assay were used to evaluate the effect of TAX on targeted genes. A nude mouse xenograft model was constructed to determine the inhibitory effects of TAX on PC in vivo. RESULTS: TAX suppressed PC cell proliferation by promoting apoptosis and inducing cell cycle arrest in vitro and in vivo. Mechanistically, TAX interacted with MDM2, a critical regulator of proliferation, and decreased its stability by inducing ubiquitin-mediated degradation, which facilitates the nuclear translocation of p53 and downregulation of CXCL5 transcription, ultimately suppressing PC cell proliferation. CONCLUSION: MDM2/p53/CXCL5 is the key pathway of TAX inhibiting the proliferation of PC cells.
abstract_zh: 背景：胰腺癌（PC）是一种发展机制复杂且预后不良的恶性肿瘤。蒲公英甾醇（TAX）是一种来源于蒙古蒲公英的五环三萜类植物甾醇，具有多种生物活性，包括抗肿瘤作用。然而，TAX在胰腺癌中发挥抗癌作用的机制尚不清楚。目的：本研究旨在阐明TAX抑制胰腺癌细胞增殖的分子机制。方法：通过网络药理学获得TAX与胰腺癌靶点的交集。利用RNA-seq鉴定TAX诱导的胰腺癌差异表达基因。采用分子对接、CETSA、western blot分析和qRT-PCR验证靶点的有效性。通过MTT实验、集落形成实验和流式细胞术分别分析增殖、凋亡和细胞周期，评估TAX对胰腺癌的影响。利用Co-IP实验和免疫荧光实验评估TAX对靶基因的作用。构建裸鼠异种移植模型以确定TAX在体内对胰腺癌的抑制作用。结果：TAX通过促进凋亡和诱导细胞周期阻滞，在体外和体内抑制胰腺癌细胞增殖。机制上，TAX与MDM2（一种关键的增殖调控因子）相互作用，并通过诱导泛素介导的降解降低其稳定性，从而促进p53的核转位和CXCL5转录的下调，最终抑制胰腺癌细胞增殖。结论：MDM2/p53/CXCL5是TAX抑制胰腺癌细胞增殖的关键通路。
